drafts.explanation: Find the pen whose y is behind the white box (smallest y / closest x among those with y < box.y) and place it to the left of the box after clearing any blockers at the target spot.
Identify the white box via reference role and the pen behind it by smallest y (and closest x), clear the left-of target spot, then pick that pen and place it left of the box.
